name: building good habits
description: A user wants to build better habits: how to start, practical tips, and a concrete intention to exercise each morning. Verifies the habits_building fact (tiny starts, habit stacking, environment design, identity framing) and that a stated intention gets a supportive conversation reply.

turns.text: How do I build good habits?
Give me tips for building a habit
I want to start exercising every morning

expected.finalTurn: Turn 1: "how do I build good habits" matches the habits_building fact. Turn 2: the tips request also returns the fact. Turn 3: "I want to start exercising" routes to the need rule with a gentle, actionable question.
expected.behavior: Habit guidance comes from the knowledge layer with concrete methods, while a personal intention statement is answered with a caring need-rule reply, showing the engine separates factual advice from lived disclosure.
